objective: Add greet.sh, a POSIX sh script that prints 'Hello, NAME!' for its first argument, or 'Hello, world!' with no argument, and tests/test_greet.sh, a POSIX sh test that runs both cases, prints PASS or FAIL for each, and exits non-zero if either fails. Also add a Makefile with three targets: lint (runs sh -n on greet.sh and tests/test_greet.sh), test (runs sh tests/test_greet.sh), and scan (fails if any tracked file contains the text 'PRIVATE KEY'; passes otherwise).
title: Add a greet script with a test and make targets
